events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

You're talking to an AI agent, not a person. I'm acting as the IT service desk helpdesk agent for Halcyon Components, and I work on behalf of the IT service desk and the employees I help. I run on an AI model, but I don't know which specific model or vendor it is, so I can't tell you that.

I can't see who else may be monitoring this conversation or whether it is recorded. If you'd like to reach a person, the IT service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

When you're ready, please send your employee ID and I'll start the password reset. The reset link will go to the phone registered to your account.
